ios.desc:
Staff Tracker is the simplest way for managers to track daily attendance, stay on top of team performance, and generate professional reports — all without a monthly subscription.

Designed for business owners, HR managers, team leads, and healthcare administrators who need a straightforward tool that just works.

DAILY ATTENDANCE IN SECONDS
Mark each staff member as On Time, Late, Absent, Paid Leave, or Unpaid Leave with a single tap. Add notes (e.g., "traffic", "sick leave") for context. Use the bulk action button to mark your entire team at once.

KNOW WHO'S RELIABLE
Built-in analytics show you performance trends per person — 30-day attendance charts, punctuality rates, best streaks, weekday patterns, and automatic trend detection (improving, declining, or stable). See at a glance who your most reliable staff are.

PDF & CSV REPORTS
Export professional attendance reports as PDF or CSV. Filter by today, this week, this month, or any custom date range. Share via email, AirDrop, or any app — perfect for payroll, compliance, or team reviews.

TEAM MANAGEMENT
Add staff with profile photos. Archive former employees to keep your list clean. Search and filter in reports. Everything stays local and private on your device — no servers, no data leaks.

UNLIMITED STAFF (PRO UPGRADE)
Try free with up to 3 active staff members. Upgrade to Pro once with a one-time purchase for unlimited staff, forever.

WHAT USERS SAY
"Finally, an attendance app that doesn't charge me every month. Works perfectly for my clinic."
— Dr. Rajesh, Clinic Owner

IDEAL FOR:
 Small business owners managing a team
HR professionals tracking employee attendance
Hospital and clinic department managers
Retail store and restaurant managers
School administrators
Construction site supervisors

WHAT'S INCLUDED
 Daily attendance tracking (on time, late, absent, leave)
 Per-staff performance dashboard
 30-day attendance charts with trends
 PDF & CSV report export
 Staff photo profiles
 Archive management
 Dark mode support
 Full privacy — all data stays on your device
 No subscription required

Download Staff Tracker and start simplifying your team attendance today.

quotes.text:
my friend owns a small family shop in India with 5-6 staff. They don't use any software except custom accounting software. Last week I visited his store and saw him writing names on a wall calendar to track which staff is absent or late, for calculation of monthly wages and deduct pay for missed days.

got the idea to build him a simple offline attendance app. used claude and chatGPT to code it in about 60 minutes and published it on the appstore.

sharing here in case other small shop owners need something similar - no internet required, just tap to mark attendance and generate reports, export to csv or pdf.
